purpose: Track an obligation already contained in exact accepted terms after source engagement closure without reopening/mutating the source engagement or creating new commercial/runtime authority.

PENDING_TRIGGER.meaning: Accepted continuing duty exists but its exact trigger/due condition has not authentically occurred.
requires: trigger/due condition defined by accepted terms
evidence trigger has not yet occurred or due time has not arrived

DUE.meaning: The accepted trigger/due condition has authentically occurred and the obligation remains unresolved.
requires: obligation not already SATISFIED or WAIVED
DUE.work_effect: NONE; due status alone does not authorize consequential work

IN_PROGRESS.meaning: Authentic evidence shows authorized performance of the due continuing duty has begun and is not yet resolved.
requires: separate applicable authorization for any consequential work

SATISFIED.meaning: Authentic evidence shows the exact continuing duty was fulfilled within its accepted scope.
requires: completion/satisfaction evidence appropriate to obligation type

WAIVED.meaning: Authentic evidence from an authorized party shows the continuing duty was validly waived within that party's authority.
requires: no inference from silence, non-enforcement or repository state

BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED.meaning: Evidence classification that a due accepted duty is not satisfied; not a legal breach/enforceability conclusion.
requires: evidence of non-satisfaction, refusal, failed required performance, or applicable accepted period elapsing without satisfaction

FAIL_CLOSED.meaning: Authentic lifecycle state cannot be determined.
requires_any: required consequential-work authorization cannot be established for an asserted IN_PROGRESS state

transitions: DUE -> IN_PROGRESS | SATISFIED | WAIVED | BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED | FAIL_CLOSED
BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED -> SATISFIED | WAIVED | FAIL_CLOSED when later authentic cure/waiver evidence exists; historical non-satisfaction evidence is retained
source_closure_immutability: Source engagement remains COMPLETE_WITH_SUCCESSOR_OBLIGATION and is never reopened, mutated or reclassified by this lifecycle.
owner_refs: exact accepted proposal/SOW/version and successor-obligation handoff
StegVerse-Labs/StegBusiness-Ops contract lifecycle evidence where applicable
authorization_boundary: Lifecycle state and work authority are independent. PENDING_TRIGGER/DUE do not authorize work. IN_PROGRESS requires separate applicable authorization for any consequential service, data, provider, credential, custody, mutation or runtime action.
legal_boundary: BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED is descriptive evidence only and does not establish legal breach, damages, default, enforceability or remedy.
